verdict.reason: The pages say api.blotato.com is not a valid base URL, give the two valid URLs, and say not to trust an agent's claim of an outage.

steps.text: api.blotato.com is not a valid base URL, so your agent guessed wrong when it used it.
For the REST API (direct HTTP, n8n, Make), use https://backend.blotato.com/v2. For the MCP Server, use https://mcp.blotato.com/mcp.
If an AI agent tells you Blotato is returning a persistent API error, do not trust that summary. Open the Logs and read the raw response.
